scope: Exact isolated Marcher-only phases and prepared Web/aura/Rout/Gravity inputs; no full-round, full-match or complete Lord-effect integration.

trace_identity.scope: isolated phases; explicit fields/actors; no Lord reactions

independent_replay.environment: Linux CPython replay of the uploaded Windows Godot reference; no local Godot 4.7.2 execution.

timing_report.scope: three isolated 200-tick phases; ordinary/dense/Gravity inputs; no full game or doctrine

phase_modes.batch_phase: public resolve; includes validation, import, all rule events and final publication; excludes MARCHING_TICK recording
phase_modes.trace_phase: same public resolve plus all 200 exact tick frames
phase_modes.phase_prepare: owned context copy and validated column import only
phase_modes.prepared_batch_work: phase.run after preparation; includes tick work, rule events and final publication

timing_report.layout_scope: validated import and publication only; RowBoundary is not a competing optimized row-based tick kernel
timing_report.memory_scope: deduplicated reachable Python object bytes; neither process RSS nor incremental allocator usage

timing_interpretation.scope: Three isolated 200-tick phases; CPU/wall and layout-boundary measurements, not full-game speed.
timing_interpretation.comparison: Linux and Windows reports use different hardware/Python; their difference does not measure an optimization or regression.
timing_interpretation.variability: Ordinary wall batch range 36.58-96.52 ms; dense 83.44-211.53 ms. Treat means as observed run results, not stable capacity guarantees.
timing_interpretation.cpu_samples: Reported CPU values are quantized in 15.625 ms increments. Zero short-operation samples do not mean zero CPU cost; use wall distributions for boundary-cost interpretation.
timing_interpretation.layout: RowBoundary compares validated import/publication only; there is no competing row tick kernel.
timing_interpretation.gravity: 13 of 14 Marchers are consumed, leaving a much smaller field.
timing_interpretation.profile: Separate instrumented profiles identify movement/nearby searches as dominant; profiled durations are excluded from throughput samples.

next_milestone: Integrate the remaining round lifecycle and reactions toward the first legitimate independent setup-to-victory reference, without fixture bridges; optimize measured search costs against exact references and measure complete games.
